description: Defines the EffectedPermissions interface for managing granted and revoked permissions within the policies module, including JSON serialization details and schema version support.

classes.name: EffectedPermissions
classes.description: Interface for permissions affected by permission effects (grant/revoke), supporting JSON serialization and schema versioning.

classes.name: EffectedPermissions.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class enumerating JSON fields for EffectedPermissions, including schema version, grant, and revoke fields.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new EffectedPermissions instance with specified granted and revoked permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by EffectedPermissions (only V_2).

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions for a given PermissionEffect (grant or revoke).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes EffectedPermissions to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes EffectedPermissions to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
